'''Motes Grubber''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wyld Woods}}, {{zone|West Village}}, {{zone|Stillgore Chateau}}, and {{Zone|The Mountaintop}}. They eat rift items in exchange for {{motes}}. Consuming {{Item|McGrubber's Burger}}s increases the number of Motes offered by 5%, up to a maximum of 25%.
